initialExam.title: IBPS PO 2026
initialExam.description: IBPS Probationary Officer exam for recruitment in 11 public sector banks. One of the most sought-after banking exams.
initialExam.eligibility: Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University
initialExam.syllabus: Prelims: English (30Q), Quant (35Q), Reasoning (35Q). Mains: Reasoning & Computer (45Q), GK/Banking (40Q), English (35Q), Data Analysis (35Q), English Descriptive.
initialExam.examPattern: Prelims: 100 questions, 100 marks, 1 hour. Mains: 155 questions + Descriptive, 200+25 marks, 3 hours + 30 min.
initialExam.jobRole: Probationary Officer in public sector banks
initialExam.careerGrowth: PO → Branch Manager → Regional Manager → Zonal Manager → GM → ED → MD/CEO.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit ibps.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Upload documents 5. Pay fee 6. Submit

salaryRange.description: Basic Pay (12th Bipartite Settlement) + DA + HRA

initialExam.perks: Leased accommodation, Medical insurance, LFC, Performance bonus, Loans at concessional rates
